007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Agent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013
014/**
015 * Drops an existing Select AI agent owned by the connected database user.
016 *
017 * <p>This sample changes database state. Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER},
018 * {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD}, {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}, and
019 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_NAME}. Confirm the agent name before running it.
020 * Optionally set {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_DROP_FORCE=true} to request a force
021 * drop; the default is {@code false}. See {@code samples/README.md} for build
022 * and run commands.</p>
023 */
024public final class DropAgentSample {
025
026    private DropAgentSample() {
027    }
028
029    /**
030     * Loads and drops the named agent.
031     *
032     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
033     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
034     */
035    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
036        String agentName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_NAME");
037        boolean force = Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_DROP_FORCE", "false"));
038        try (SelectAIAgent client = createClient()) {
039            Agent agent = client.agent(agentName);
040            System.out.printf("Drop agent '%s' completed: %s%n", agentName, agent.drop(force));
041        }
042    }
043
044    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
045        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
046                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
047                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
048                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
049                .build());
050    }
051
052    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
053        String value = System.getenv(name);
054        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
055            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
056        }
057        return value;
058    }
059
060    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
061        String value = System.getenv(name);
062        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
063    }
064}
